name: Excel Extractor — UI-only RAG operating-guide ingestion
description: Manual, UI-only ingestion of the portable Excel Extractor operating guide into PGVector. Compatible with n8n 2.30.8.

nodes.name: Run once to (re)ingest operating guide
nodes.notes: UI-only bootstrap. Configure the PostgreSQL and embedding credentials first, then click Test workflow. Do not activate this workflow; it is a deliberate manual ingestion job.

nodes.name: RAG runtime configuration
nodes.notes: UI EDIT: Keep this table name identical to the core workflow node “PGVector operating context”. If the corporate embedding model has different dimensions, choose a NEW table name here and in the core before the first ingest.

nodes.name: RAG documents — portable operating guide
nodes.notes: Exact portable source is also delivered as n8n/rag/excel-agent-operating-guide.documents.json for review and version control. This embedded copy is intentionally used so import/run needs only n8n UI.

nodes.name: Default Data Loader — guide text
nodes.notes: Loads text and durable metadata from each document item. It is a sub-node of the PGVector insertion node.

nodes.name: Recursive Character Text Splitter — 1000/150
nodes.notes: A small static guide is chunked consistently before embedding.

nodes.name: PGVector — insert operating guide
nodes.notes: UI REQUIRED: select the corporate PostgreSQL/pgvector credential. This node auto-creates a fresh table using the connected embedding dimensions. Re-running inserts another copy; use a new table for a clean re-ingest unless IT has an approved cleanup process.

nodes.name: OpenAI Embeddings — REPLACE WITH CORPORATE EMBEDDING
nodes.notes: Placeholder only. In the UI replace this sub-node with the corporate embedding integration/model, then attach the SAME model and embedding dimensions to core → “PGVector operating context”. The 180-second timeout is a conservative ingestion limit; do not run with an unconfigured placeholder.
